Mike Chen: Quick microbench run this morning across L4 / T4 / A10G (us-west1, eu-west1). Focus: embeddings + small-chat (8–32 tokens). Putting the topline numbers here and attaching CSV/sparklines.

Mike Chen: Embeddings (p50 / p95): L4 14ms / 48ms, T4 22ms / 93ms, A10G 11ms / 35ms. Throughput (embeds qps sustained): L4 ~180, T4 ~110, A10G ~240.

Mike Chen: Small-chat (8-token generation p50 / p95): L4 32ms / 120ms, T4 60ms / 220ms, A10G 24ms / 95ms. Batch sizes: embed b=64, chat b=8. Quant: fp16 on L4/A10G, int8 on T4 for cost runs.

Arya Patel: Nice. Did you hold kernel choices constant between regions? any tiling/attention flags?

Mike Chen: Kernels: L4/A10G used fused_attention_v2 + amp matmul; T4 used cuda-matmul + legacy attention kernel with per-op tiling tuned. Flags: `--kv-cache-warmup=1000 --pad-to-multiple=8`.

Liz Gomez: Did you do KV warmup effects? that can swing p50 on chat.

Mike Chen: Yup — 1k warmup prefixes for chat. Warmup improves p50 by ~12% for A10G, ~8% for L4, negligible for T4 in this config.

Samir Rao: What about cost apples-to-apples? spot pricing varies but rough cost/1M tokens: L4 $12, T4 $6.8, A10G $21 (GPU-only compute cost, excludes infra tax). Int8 on T4 gives the low cost but perf hit and small quality delta.

Samir Rao: Any embedding quality regressions with int8 on T4?

Mike Chen: Ran 10k-pair eval (cosine similarity vs fp16 baseline): L4 int8 delta -0.002, T4 int8 delta -0.006, A10G fp16 baseline ~0.000. So T4 int8 shows a small but measurable shift. Not catastrophic but above our 0.005 alert threshold.

eval-bot: PERF-ALERT: T4 int8 embedding cosine drop 0.006 > threshold 0.005. Creating ticket #INC-423 (assign: eng-ml).

Liz Gomez: Ok — let's schedule a re-tune for T4 int8 (per-channel quant + calibration sweep). Also try alternative kernel tiling params; sometimes that reduces quant noise.

Mike Chen: Will run a 3x sweep this afternoon: per-channel vs symmetric int8, calibration size 2k vs 10k. Pushing artifacts to /mnt/bench/1768501234.json and a CSV to s3.

Arya Patel: Capacity sizing question — if product targets 1k qps for embeddings, roughly how many nodes per GPU type?

Mike Chen: Back-of-envelope based on sustained qps: L4 ~180 qps/node -> ~6 nodes, T4 ~110 qps/node -> ~10 nodes, A10G ~240 qps/node -> ~5 nodes. Add 20% headroom for burst/autoscale.

Arya Patel: Good. Any region differences? us-west vs eu-west?

Mike Chen: Latency p50 ~5–7ms worse in eu-west due to network egress and slightly older NICs on that fleet. Kernel perf roughly same.

Liz Gomez: Action items: (1) Mike run T4 int8 re-tune + kernel tiling sweep; (2) Samir create cost memo with infra taxes; (3) Arya work capacity plan with 20% headroom. 

Mike Chen: Ack. I'll post the sweep results as separate threads but will update this thread with the ticket and link once ready.

Arya Patel: Thx — these numbers help when discussing Dedicated sizing with Sales.

Mike Chen: Link to CSV + charts: https://redwood.link/bench/1768501234 (internal).
